timeline.summary: Mr. Swapnil Jatinbhai Shah, Promoter, disclosed no new encumbrances on Senores Pharmaceuticals shares for FY2026 beyond prior disclosures.
Senores Pharmaceuticals reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹175.19 Cr and PAT of ₹36.67 Cr, and announced changes in key managerial personnel.
